stationScope.evidence: The official Stadtwerke Hamm hammerLADESTROM page publishes own-network prices separately from roaming: 0.45 EUR/kWh AC and 0.89 EUR/kWh DC. Blocking fee is 0.10 EUR/min after 180 min AC or 120 min DC, capped at 12 EUR per charging session on Stadtwerke Hamm points. Public EVSE records identify DE*HLS as Stadtwerke Hamm, including DE*HLS*ED24012*01 and DE*HLS*ED24017*01/*02.

roamingDeferred.reason: Stadtwerke Hamm explicitly states that third-party operator prices differ and are shown separately. Never propagate roaming prices to physical third-party CPOs.

note: hammerLADESTROM has no monthly base fee. The official page requires app registration and SEPA billing; an RFID card/keyfob is optional for a one-time 10 EUR setup fee. No unverified ad-hoc price is inferred.
